lead_intro: Autoimmunity is a complex yet fascinating phenomenon where your immune system turns against your own body, leading to various diseases. Let's test your understanding of this topic with a quiz!

quiz.question: What is autoimmunity?
choices: A condition where your immune system attacks foreign invaders
A condition where your immune system attacks your own body
A condition where your immune system is weakened
quiz.answer: A condition where your immune system attacks your own body
quiz.explanation: Autoimmunity is when your immune system mistakenly targets and attacks healthy tissues in your body, thinking they are foreign invaders.

quiz.question: What triggers autoimmunity?
quiz.explanation: Infections can trigger autoimmunity by activating your immune system and leading to a misguided attack on your own tissues.

quiz.question: How do autoimmune diseases affect the body?
choices: They can affect any tissue in the body
They only affect the digestive system
quiz.answer: They can affect any tissue in the body
quiz.explanation: Autoimmune diseases can impact various tissues in the body, including nerves, joints, pancreas, and more, leading to a wide range of symptoms and complications.

quiz.question: What is the role of T cells in autoimmunity?
choices: T cells activate the immune system against healthy tissues
quiz.answer: T cells activate the immune system against healthy tissues
quiz.explanation: In autoimmunity, T cells can mistakenly recognize healthy proteins as invaders and trigger an immune response against the body's own tissues.

quiz.question: Why are autoimmune diseases still present in the population despite being harmful?
choices: They provide evolutionary advantages in fighting infections
quiz.answer: They provide evolutionary advantages in fighting infections
quiz.explanation: Autoimmune diseases may have persisted in the population due to past evolutionary advantages in combating infectious diseases, even though they pose risks in modern times.
